entries.candidate: Kansai Electric / CyrusOne (KEP) OSK2: （仮称）箕面市粟生間谷東二丁目計画, Minoh, Osaka — MLIT structural-method certification MNNNNNN-13023 of 18 September 2026 (applicant 関西電力サイラスワンOSK2合同会社)
entries.reason: New in-window government record: MLIT's register of structural-method certifications (mlit-010-kenchikubutsu.pdf, sha256 b6180152..., page 3 of pdftotext output; certifications to 30 September 2026) lists '（仮称）箕面市粟生間谷東二丁目計画' for 関西電力サイラスワンOSK2合同会社 (Nakanoshima 3-chome, Osaka; evaluation by the General Building Research Corporation of Japan), certification MNNNNNN-13023 dated 18 September 2026, the first certification of this building. The SPV name matches KEP's numbering (OSK1 is CyrusOne KEP's Keihanna data centre, MLIT 'ATOSK1 Project'), so this is very likely KEP's second data-centre building, but the register does not state the use and gives the location only as the town block 粟生間谷東二丁目 in Minoh. No lot, address or site map was found: CyrusOne's sitemap and Osaka page (cyrusone-osaka-japan.html) list only OSK1; Minoh City's landscape-council minutes of 25 May and 26 August 2026, its development-procedure pages and the Kawai-Yamanokuchi planning page have no OSK2 item; Osaka Prefecture has not yet published an FY2026 building-environment-plan list; kepco.co.jp blocks robots. A town-block point would not be an admissible locator. Whether the site lies in the Kawai-Yamanokuchi readjustment area (jp-kansai-p1 lead) is not established. Not in the Atlas; the ESR/Colt Minoh hold is in 粟生間谷東八丁目, a different block.
entries.reopen_condition: A Minoh City, Osaka Prefecture (for example an FY2026 building-environment-plan entry), Kansai Electric or CyrusOne record giving the OSK2 lot, address or site map and confirming data-centre use; then admit as announced from the 18 September 2026 certification while it is within the window (85 days: until about 12 December 2026), with an MOJ parcel (Minoh 27220) or address locator.

entries.candidate: MC Digital Realty NRT campus, Inzai: NRT14 existing operations (also NRT10 and NRT12)
entries.reason: New in-window status evidence: Digital Realty's 7 October 2026 KIX15 release (already Atlas evidence 9da71980-7c02-5f24-b1d2-1ea88c66e2a3, local country-research-2026-10-16-investor_filings/dlr-kix15-release-20261007.html, bytes 123843-124393) says KIX15 'follows the opening of the NRT14 Data Center in Inzai City, Chiba Prefecture, earlier this year' and that 'NRT14 is one of the first facilities in Japan to achieve the DGX-Ready Data Center certification'. MCDR's NRT page (mcdr-nrt.html) gives NRT10 (opened September 2021, 37,850 m2, 39 MW), NRT12 (March 2024, 27,571 m2, 34 MW) and NRT14 (April 2026, 22,867 m2, 25 MW), location 千葉県印西市 only. Digital Realty's facility pages (dlr-nrt10/12/14.html) give the addresses 2-9-3, 2-4-1 and 2-4-3 Otsuka, Inzai-city, which match MOJ/AIGID registry lots 大塚二丁目9-3 (16,546 m2), 4-1 (31,421 m2) and 4-3 (994 m2). The locator is not resolved: the same pages' embedded coordinates contradict the addresses for NRT10 (point in lot 4-2, 314 m from lot 9-3) and NRT12 (35.83479, 140.16361, about 4.5 km away); NRT14's point (35.808316, 140.119366) lies in lot 4-1, 47 m from lot 4-3, but on a large building already present in the undated GSI aerial photo, whereas NRT14 was built from 2025; lot 4-3 alone (994 m2) cannot hold a 22,867 m2, six-storey building. The Atlas SCSK netXDC Inzai Campus point (Google SI3 marker) lies in the abutting lot 大塚二丁目5, 137 m from NRT14's point, so building-to-lot identity in this cluster needs an independent record before a new site is placed beside it. Not in the Atlas; distinct from Colt Inzai 4 (lot 8, admitted in this fragment).
entries.reopen_condition: An official or operator record tying NRT14 (or NRT10/NRT12) to specific lots or a building outline (Inzai City building or development record, MCDR site map, dated aerial imagery showing the 2025-2026 construction), checked against the SCSK campus. The 7 October 2026 status statement stays in window until about 31 December 2026.

entries.reason: Status: Keppel DC REIT's 3Q 2026 update (published 23 October 2026, portfolio as at 30 September 2026; Atlas evidence a7a87ecb...) lists Tokyo Data Centre 1 with one client, 100% occupancy, a shell-and-core triple-net lease under which the client is responsible for facilities management, WALE 5.1 years and completion 2019; the Annual Report 2025 gives the address, land area 96,185 sq ft (8,936 m2) and Jones Lang LaSalle K.K. as facility manager. entries.reopen_condition: An operator, owner or municipal record tying Tokyo Data Centre 1 to lot 22-1 or 22-2 (or a building outline), plus a statement naming its operator or confirming data-centre operation, while the 30 September 2026 observation is within 85 days of an update (to about 24 December 2026).
